method: Three alternating fresh AOT pairs per surface; 160 measured iterations, 15 mount warmups and 30 update warmups; 120x40. Serial native execution outside the filesystem sandbox. No own tests or compilation ran during timings. Host is shared, not an isolated performance lab. Median of process medians.
boundaries: Terminal timings include mutation, build/layout/paint, exact diff and commit. Structured timings add presentation planning, synchronous post-commit semantic flush, coverage, semantic diff and real wire encoding; no event dispatch, actual scheduling delay, transport, DOM or terminal display. Control trees contain short labels. 64/256-row cases extend beyond the viewport. No total-RAM or allocation-rate claim.
parity: All 48 control-tree cases have matching final rendered-text fingerprints and every measured frame changes output. Sample mounts have no captured fingerprint; functional regressions cover geometry/order/lifecycle.
trialNotes: The three trial CSVs predate the derived-geometry merge and use main cc3569d3. Attachment/semantic trials used the earlier terminal-only harness; pipeline trial used the extended harness. Those trials ran in the filesystem sandbox and are exploratory; the final latest-main native measurements supersede their absolute timings.
